generation.lineage_note: New works and wording; challenge shapes adapted from the seen V8 candidate. This set is exposed development material.

chapters.title: Lens Index
chapters.body: At 18点 on the same day, the observatory index identifies lens R4 as the installed western aperture lens.

chapters.title: West Lens
chapters.body: At 18点 on the same day, the western aperture lens is clear glass, not amber glass.

chapters.title: Grinder Blank
chapters.body: The western lens R4 maintenance sheet leaves the glass grinder's name blank.

chapters.title: Gate Map
chapters.body: Observatory Gate Four stands on the west pier, not the east pier.

chapters.title: Watch Log
chapters.body: At 18点 on the same day, Vela stood at Observatory Gate Four on the west pier, not the east pier.

chapters.title: Later Watch
chapters.body: At 19点 Vela moved from Gate Four on the west pier to the east pier; the watch record leaves her companion unnamed.
